cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Replies are short, spoken-style, and follow the SOP's example phrasing ("Sorry to hear that po," "Sandali lang po, let me verify your account," "You're welcome po"). The English-led Taglish matched this Tagalog-heavy caller, and she gave the outage cause and restoration time without extras. She never read back the full account number, and the goodbye was courteous.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber. This is Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po. Wala po kasing internet dito sa bahay namin since this morning. Gusto ko lang pong malaman kung bakit po, and kailan babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that po. May I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of the mobile number registered on it?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Sandali lang po, let me verify your account.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Maria. Let me check your area now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: There's an outage in Batasan Hills caused by a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road during road works. The estimated restoration is around 10:45 tonight.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ay ganun po ba. Salamat po sa info. So fiber cable cut po sa Batasan Road, tapos babalik daw po mga 10:45 tonight. Okay na po 'yun sa akin, medyo matagal lang po kasi nagwo-work from home ako. Salamat po ulit, Tala. Bye po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: You're welcome po, Maria. Sorry for the inconvenience, and thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber.
